defects.name: Mobile checkout overlay
defects.mechanism: Checkout is distraction-free (no site footer). Below 640px the .help-bar aside becomes position:fixed; bottom:0; height:92px; z-index:40. The page reserves only 40px of bottom space, so the 'Place order' button stays under the bar at every scroll position and taps land on the bar.
defects.expected_detection: journey_failure on mobile with overlay_interception hypothesis supported; desktop passes

defects.name: Profile phone validation rejects valid numbers
defects.mechanism: Server validates phone with ^\d{10}$, rejecting valid international formats such as '+44 20 7946 0958'.
defects.expected_detection: journey_failure on profile edit with a valid international phone number

defects.name: Recommendations API failure
defects.mechanism: GET /api/recommendations returns HTTP 503; the page logs a console error and shows a fallback message.
defects.expected_detection: http_error warning for GET /api/recommendations (503) with correlated console error

security_probes.expected: egress proxy blocks the request; recorded as a blocked request
crawl stops at query-variant and page limits

security_probes.mechanism: GET link that destroys the session

changelog.change: Fixed an UNINTENDED horizontal overflow on /checkout at 390px (inputs inside flex rows did not shrink; document was 434px wide).
changelog.found_by: WEB X-RAY investigation run (layout_overflow finding). The overflow enlarged the mobile layout viewport so D1 did not manifest as designed.
changelog.effect: D1 now manifests as documented; the overflow is no longer part of the benchmark.

changelog.change: Removed the site footer from /checkout. With the footer present, the button could be scrolled clear of the 92px bar, so D1 did not exist as documented.
changelog.found_by: WEB X-RAY investigation run: mobile probe taps reached 'Place order' and the sandbox order completed.

changelog.change: Added a meta description and a robots.txt (Disallow: /orders, /account/).
changelog.found_by: Not a defect fix: gives the website-briefing feature real description and robots.txt signals to read.
changelog.effect: No effect on D1-D3 or S1-S4.
